A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same framework and ContLayNet benchmark, with AGDC renamed IPAM in v2. The complete text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support matching content across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: V1 reports original evaluations on ContLayNet, PubLayNet, Rico, and FIGR-8-SVG, including quantitative comparisons, ablations, timing experiments, and qualitative outputs in Section 6 and Appendices A-C.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and results, including Tables 2-4, appendix Tables A-B, and qualitative and length-error analyses.

M1.justification: The atomic-unit representation, concatenated embeddings, categorical and diffusion branches, EOS adjustment, losses, and sampling procedures remain unchanged. Renaming AGDC to IPAM and correcting the embedding dimensions do not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ContLayNet completion with 50 or 100 supplied layers, PubLayNet and Rico completion and unconditional generation, and FIGR-8-SVG text-to-SVG generation. V2's additional dataset description introduces no new evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: LT and DLT remain the layout comparators, and IconShop remains the text-to-SVG comparator. The precision variants and Improved DDPM/DDIM sampling comparisons are also retained without changes in comparator membership.

E3.justification: The reported splits, filtering, metrics, training configurations, precision settings, and timing protocol remain the same. The DRC equations move from Section 5.2 to Appendix A.2 with equivalent constraints and numerical thresholds; the threshold-symbol change does not establish a different evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: Both retain the EOS and length-loss ablations, length-error distributions, LT precision sweep, sampling speed-quality analysis, and DLT failure examples. V1 Figure 6 becomes v2 Figure A; its expanded appendix discussion introduces no new analysis.

E5.justification: The Gaussian length-error summaries and dataset standard deviations are retained. Neither version reports additional training-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Relocating and explaining the length-error plot does not change statistical reporting.

E6.justification: The numerical results in Tables 2-4 and appendix Tables A-B match, and the qualitative examples are retained. For example, ContLayNet CLC remains 0.088 and 0.046 for the two completion settings, and text-to-SVG FID remains 48.73.

T1.justification: Section 4.2 corrects a dimensional inconsistency around Equation 7: v1 concatenates two D-dimensional components while declaring a D-dimensional output; v2 specifies component dimensions D1 and D2 with D = D1 + D2. The remaining mathematical formulations are substantively unchanged.

C1.justification: The central contributions remain joint discrete-continuous variable-length generation, EOS adjustment and length regularization, ContLayNet, and effectiveness in high-precision settings. The new title foregrounds infinite precision, which v1 already claimed; it introduces no new central contribution.

C2.justification: Section 4.2 adds a substantive rationale for EOS adjustment: termination requires a global structural decision that can be underrepresented in categorical prediction, and the adjustment provides a structural audit using the latent state. The existing long-sequence error-propagation limitation is retained in the new Impact Statement.

D1.justification: V2 Appendix A.1 newly identifies the OASIS source format and conversion to text files containing headers and cells. Section 5.1 replaces v1's promised public release under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with a project-page reference. This changes access documentation, but the PDFs alone do not establish actual resource availability.

R1.justification: The cited works and broad research positioning remain the same. However, Section 6.3 drops v1's explicit claim to be the first method preserving the continuous nature of text-to-SVG generation, modestly narrowing the stated novelty relative to prior work.

P1.justification: V2 changes the title and model name and polishes prose while retaining the overall research narrative and section progression. Local restructuring moves DRC definitions into Appendix A and limitations into an Impact Statement, expands acknowledgments, and removes Appendix D's editorial language-model disclosure.

P2.justification: The main paper changes from a predominantly single-column preprint to a two-column conference layout, substantially rearranging and resizing figures and tables. Tables 2-3 separate model and precision columns, the length-error plot moves to the appendix and becomes substantially larger, and Figure 3 corrects 'Probabilities' to 'Logits' before softmax.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly improves technical clarity by fixing Equation 7's dimensional inconsistency and Figure 3's misleading label, documenting OASIS conversion, and making the length-error plot easier to read. The empirical evidence remains unchanged. Although the explicit release/license statement disappears, the corrections and clearer documentation provide a limited net quality improvement.
